Game Overview

In Do Not Feed the Monkeys, the core idea is straightforward: unleash your inner voyeur by monitoring strangers through hidden cameras. Experience the thrill of uncovering their secrets and dilemmas, while resisting the temptation to interfere. Remember, observing unseen is everything, but meddling might tip the balance in this captivating privacy dilemma. Will curiosity get the better of you?
